title: Using the Metabolites S7 Class
text: Metabolites object consists three main data components: samples: data.table containing metadata samples (e.g., sample IDs, collection details). features: data.table describing metabolites, including feature names additional annotations. Rows represent individual samples. Columns correspond different metabolites. third dimension (depth) represents various stages data processing (e.g., raw, scaled, post-QC). exclusions: multi-dimensional sparse character matrix layer mask corresponding layer @data matrix slot. cells contain comma separated string exclusion codes (see Quality Control article). Metabolites object also holds parameters analyses, quality control routines. default values, however can either changed object creation, later using @ operator access object’s slots.

title: Metabolite Quality Control
text: Metabolomics data often contain missing values, outliers, features require filtering downstream analysis. metabolite_qc() function provides efficient automated way perform quality control (QC) Metabolites object. vignette walks key parameters steps performing QC using function.

title: Metabolite Quality Control
text: performing QC, need Metabolites object, contains metabolomics data along metadata.
